pages.text: A fury rod and shiver tooth can be crafted into a special arrow. Claim arrows only deal half damage, but they mark your claim over those you best in combat, giving you power over your foes.$(br)If you hit a mob with a claim arrow while holding a spindle in your off-hand, the spindle will become bloodied, entangled with that mob (so long as the mob is in a loaded chunk).

If you hit the mob thrice without missing or getting hurt by it, you will be able to use the spindle (hold right-click) to summon the mob. This expends the spindle.$(br2)After nine hits, you can toss the spindle into a block focus (NOT an item focus) and it will act as if the mob were in that focus.
